<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>false</active><api_name>x_snc_aegis.AEGISResumeScorer</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>AEGISResumeScorer</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var AEGISResumeScorer = Class.create();
AEGISResumeScorer.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    /**
     * Deterministic 5-factor weighted fit calculation.
     * Weights: Skills 30%, Experience 25%, Projects 20%, Certifications 15%, Education 10%.
     */
    calculateFitScore: function(matchedSkillsCount, totalRequiredSkills,
                                candidateExpYears, requiredExpYears,
                                relevantProjectsCount, candidateCertsCount,
                                requiredCertsCount, educationMatch) {

        // Factor 1: Skills (30%)
        var skillsScore = 0;
        if (totalRequiredSkills > 0) {
            skillsScore = Math.min(100, Math.round((matchedSkillsCount / totalRequiredSkills) * 100));
        }

        // Factor 2: Experience (25%)
        var expScore = 0;
        if (requiredExpYears > 0) {
            expScore = Math.min(100, Math.round((candidateExpYears / requiredExpYears) * 100));
        } else {
            expScore = 100;
        }

        // Factor 3: Projects (20%) — benchmark is 3 projects for full score
        var projScore = Math.min(100, Math.round((relevantProjectsCount / 3) * 100));

        // Factor 4: Certifications (15%) — benchmark is 2 certs if none required
        var certScore = 0;
        if (requiredCertsCount > 0) {
            certScore = Math.min(100, Math.round((candidateCertsCount / requiredCertsCount) * 100));
        } else {
            certScore = Math.min(100, Math.round((candidateCertsCount / 2) * 100));
        }

        // Factor 5: Education (10%)
        var eduScore = 50;
        if (educationMatch === 'exact' || educationMatch === 'exceeds') {
            eduScore = 100;
        } else if (educationMatch === 'related') {
            eduScore = 75;
        } else if (educationMatch === 'none') {
            eduScore = 25;
        }

        var fitScore = Math.round(
            (skillsScore * 0.30) +
            (expScore * 0.25) +
            (projScore * 0.20) +
            (certScore * 0.15) +
            (eduScore * 0.10)
        );

        return {
            fit_score: fitScore,
            skills_score: skillsScore,
            experience_score: expScore,
            projects_score: projScore,
            certifications_score: certScore,
            education_score: eduScore
        };
    },

    /**
     * Case-insensitive skill matching between candidate CSV and requisition CSV.
     */
    matchSkills: function(candidateSkillsStr, requiredSkillsStr) {
        if (!requiredSkillsStr) {
            return { matched: [], missing: [], matchedCount: 0, totalRequired: 0 };
        }

        var required = requiredSkillsStr.split(',').map(function(s) { return s.trim(); });
        var candidate = (candidateSkillsStr || '').split(',').map(function(s) { return s.trim().toLowerCase(); });

        var matched = [];
        var missing = [];

        for (var i = 0; i < required.length; i++) {
            var reqSkill = required[i];
            if (candidate.indexOf(reqSkill.toLowerCase()) !== -1) {
                matched.push(reqSkill);
            } else {
                missing.push(reqSkill);
            }
        }

        return {
            matched: matched,
            missing: missing,
            matchedCount: matched.length,
            totalRequired: required.length
        };
    },

    /**
     * Generates a human-readable, auditable explanation.
     */
    generateExplanation: function(breakdown, matchedSkills, missingSkills) {
        var parts = [];
        parts.push('Overall Fit Score: ' + breakdown.fit_score + '/100.');
        parts.push('Skills Match (' + breakdown.skills_score + '/100): Matched [' +
            matchedSkills + ']' +
            (missingSkills ? '; Missing [' + missingSkills + ']' : '') + '.');
        parts.push('Experience (' + breakdown.experience_score + '/100).');
        parts.push('Projects (' + breakdown.projects_score + '/100).');
        parts.push('Certifications (' + breakdown.certifications_score + '/100).');
        parts.push('Education (' + breakdown.education_score + '/100).');
        return parts.join(' ');
    },

    /**
     * Evaluates candidate education against requisition requirement.
     * Returns: 'exceeds', 'exact', 'related', or 'none'.
     */
    evaluateEducation: function(candidateEdu, requiredEdu) {
        if (!requiredEdu || requiredEdu.trim() === '' || requiredEdu.toUpperCase() === 'ANY') {
            return 'exact';
        }
        if (!candidateEdu || candidateEdu.trim() === '') {
            return 'none';
        }

        var rank = {
            'DOCTORATE': 4, 'PHD': 4,
            'MASTERS': 3, 'MASTER': 3, 'MS': 3, 'MBA': 3,
            'BACHELORS': 2, 'BACHELOR': 2, 'BS': 2, 'BA': 2, 'BTECH': 2, 'BE': 2,
            'ASSOCIATES': 1, 'ASSOCIATE': 1,
            'HIGHSCHOOL': 0, 'HIGH_SCHOOL': 0, 'DIPLOMA': 0
        };

        var normalize = function(val) {
            return (val || '').toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]/g, '');
        };

        var cKey = normalize(candidateEdu);
        var rKey = normalize(requiredEdu);

        var cRank = rank[cKey] !== undefined ? rank[cKey] : -1;
        var rRank = rank[rKey] !== undefined ? rank[rKey] : -1;

        if (cRank === -1 || rRank === -1) {
            if (cKey && rKey && (cKey.indexOf(rKey) !== -1 || rKey.indexOf(cKey) !== -1)) return 'exact';
            return 'none';
        }

        if (cRank > rRank) return 'exceeds';
        if (cRank === rRank) return 'exact';
        if (cRank === rRank - 1) return 'related';
        return 'none';
    },

    /**
     * High-level candidate scoring wrapper.
     * Evaluates all 5 auditable dimensions dynamically against requisition criteria.
     * @param {Object} candidateProfile - Object with skills, years_experience, relevant_projects, certifications, education_level
     * @param {string} requiredSkillsStr - CSV of mandatory skills
     * @param {number} requiredExpYears - Requisition required years of experience
     * @param {string} requiredEdu - Requisition required education level (e.g. 'Bachelors', 'Masters')
     * @param {number} [requiredCertsCount] - Optional expected certifications benchmark (defaults to 2 if 0/unspecified)
     */
    scoreCandidate: function(candidateProfile, requiredSkillsStr, requiredExpYears, requiredEdu, requiredCertsCount) {
        var skillMatch = this.matchSkills(candidateProfile.skills, requiredSkillsStr);
        var certsCount = (candidateProfile.certifications || '').split(',').filter(function(c) { return c.trim().length > 0; }).length;
        
        var eduReq = requiredEdu || (candidateProfile.requisition ? candidateProfile.requisition.education_required : '');
        var eduMatch = this.evaluateEducation(candidateProfile.education_level, eduReq);

        var reqCerts = (requiredCertsCount !== undefined && requiredCertsCount !== null) ? parseInt(requiredCertsCount, 10) : 0;

        var breakdown = this.calculateFitScore(
            skillMatch.matchedCount,
            skillMatch.totalRequired,
            parseFloat(candidateProfile.years_experience) || 0,
            parseInt(requiredExpYears, 10) || 0,
            parseInt(candidateProfile.relevant_projects, 10) || 0,
            certsCount,
            reqCerts,
            eduMatch
        );

        breakdown.matched_skills = skillMatch.matched.join(', ');
        breakdown.missing_skills = skillMatch.missing.join(', ');
        breakdown.explanation = this.generateExplanation(breakdown, breakdown.matched_skills, breakdown.missing_skills);
        return breakdown;
    },

    type: 'AEGISResumeScorer'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>DEEPTHI</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-20 11:03:48</sys_created_on><sys_id>5f1723bf6d5f03107f44d98064d897ea</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AEGISResumeScorer</sys_name><sys_package display_value="AEGIS" source="x_snc_aegis">f1f4accb05d743107f44294ed7486a97</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="AEGIS">f1f4accb05d743107f44294ed7486a97</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_5f1723bf6d5f03107f44d98064d897ea</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 14:38:19</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
